{{Quote|Ol' Hen, he's been out in the suns without a visor a bit too long.|A Mos Eisley resident|<ref name="TM-CA3">{{WEGCite|book=Classic Adventures: Volume Three|story=Tatooine Manhunt}}</ref>}}
'''Hen'''<ref name="TM-CA3" /> was a [[Dim-U/Legends|Dim-U]] [[Priest/Legends|priest]] who preached on the streets of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. He was generally ignored by the residents of Mos Eisley.<ref name="TM" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Hen appears unnamed in the [[1988]] printing of ''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''.<ref name="TM" /> The priest was given a name when the adventure was reprinted in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Three]]'' in [[1996]].<ref name="TM-CA3" />
